text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Christmas. A holy day colored by solemn hymns. And—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(—Such a fun day!
Delicious food, cake, presents...
Everything is the absolute best!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (I want to gift my liege a wonderful day befitting a king!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If I do that...
maybe they'll praise me even more than before... Hehe.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"We need to do a lot of preparation.
And for that..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san. As a knight—I have a vital, utmost request for you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Durandal's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am Itchoken.
Pleased to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal asked me to do it.
She told me to protect you whenever she's not around.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal is throwing a Christmas party.
For you. She's very busy."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Shh! Your voice is too loud!
It's supposed to be a surprise.

It seems Durandal was planning a Christmas surprise for me.
...Though it's not much of a surprise anymore.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wait, Right O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Too slow!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you take a detour?! You should have come in a straight line!
You are a disgrace to the Order of the Straight Line!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Don't put me in some weird order of knights!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you really took a straight line here,
over trees and walls...
You're a total mess, you know.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Because you told me it was a very, very important favor, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "So, I rushed over to protect you. But you look fine now, so I'm heading back. See you tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Geez. I don't know whether I picked the wrong person or if you're just super dependable...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Um, my liege.
Did you hear anything from Light O-san?
choice_data_list: You said you'd look after things when I'm not around.
You said you'd protect them when I'm not around

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I was hoping you might lend a hand in protecting my Lord for a brief while.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With all our major goals for the year accomplished and some breathing room at hand...
I would like to request a few days off.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Please direct any requests during that time to Right O. Rest assured, if anything comes up, I shall rush over immediately.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, you haven't heard
anything else, have you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Phew.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please excuse me for now.
—I will be back by Christmas.
"And so, I ended up spending a few days apart from Durandal, but..."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ha, a crow!
Did you come to snatch this one away?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Begone, begone!
Whooooosh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However, I don't see any other enemies to defeat. This is far too boring.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever Durandal opens her mouth, it's always about you.
How she protected you, whether you're safe right now...
She was always worrying about you."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, Durandal...
what was it that you were protecting yourself from?
choice_data_list: (It's not so much where to start, but—)

text_block_list.text:
In truth, I am not the kind of person anyone would target.
And yet, Durandal was undeniably protecting me.

Now that she, who was always by my side day and night,
is gone... I realize just how immense and dependable
her presence truly was.
choice_data_list: (She really was an emotional support for me...)

text_block_list.text:
As a king, waiting may be the proper choice, but...
I want to prepare a gift of my own to repay her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ha, earthworms!
Moguuuuu!!

"And then came Christmas Day.
As expected, Durandal summoned me,
and when I headed to the designated spot—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To my liege.
Merry Christmas!

Bold, festive Christmas decorations, and an overwhelming dinner spread...
Faced with grandeur beyond my imagination, an honest gasp of admiration slipped out.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Did I surprise you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'll arrange meals tailored to my liege's tastes.
And the decorations shall be grand, befitting my liege!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?
choice_data_list: I'm so deeply touched! It makes me really happy!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. However...
it is far too early to be satisfied."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wearing my racing silks is also to show my utmost respect...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Presents are an essential part of Christmas.
Even for our King, who gives us everything—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: May a holy miracle be upon us.

Durandal kneels down and opens the box...
From within, adorned with sparkling jewels,
a truly noble—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I present this to you.
—A crown handmade by Durandal."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: With all due respect.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Receiving guidance from Believe-san,
the base fabric, the framework,
the imitation jewels...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I gathered everything myself, starting from the raw materials. It was quite a grueling task, however...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The crown I dedicate to my liege
was something I wanted to be one-of-a-kind in this world.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Because there is only one king for me.

Struck to the heart by that earnest gaze.
To be shown this much respect
as a Trainer... is the highest possible honor.
choice_data_list: Thank you. You're the best knight ever.
Thank you. You really are the greatest knight.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Words far kinder than I deserve.
However... I shall accept them with gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado—
let the coronation begin.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I thought.
In truth, I haven't been able to find an Archbishop
worthy of bestowing the crown upon my lord."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start over
another day—
choice_data_list: Then I'll leave it to you
Then, I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But, for me to take on
such a massive responsibility—
choice_data_list: I want it to be you

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...As you command.

Durandal takes the crown into her hands.
As she prepares to place the heavily ornamented piece
onto my head while I sit in the chair—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you think so?
It's only around 15 kilograms, though...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry!
For me to make such a mistake... Did I misjudge it...?!

Her anguished voice
pierces deep into my chest...
—As King, I cannot betray her expectations!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
In the flesh...!
choice_data_list: A crown... befitting a King, huh...!
A crown... befitting a King, isn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly.
...It suits you very well, my King.

It feels a bit awkward right after receiving such a splendid crown, but...
If I'm going to give you your Christmas present, now is the time.
choice_data_list: There's something I'd like to bestow upon you as well
I, too, have something to bestow upon you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: This place is...
"As a holy knight, Durandal confided her true feelings in me here... It's a place full of memories, one that I've visited time and again ever since."
choice_data_list: Durandal, get in front of me!
Durandal, get in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Standing before the kneeling Durandal,
I open the present—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Is this...
a medal?"

"It might be a bit clumsily made compared to the crown Durandal gave me...
but I poured just as much feeling into it."
choice_data_list: Thank you for all your wonderful hard work so far.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono...
choice_data_list: To my one and only knight in the whole world

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...I humbly accept this.
And I offer you my gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I give thanks for the miracle of meeting and serving a King more precious to me than life itself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"More than any knight in history,
I can state with certainty... that I am the most blessed of all."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The proof that I am your knight—the supreme honor.
Will you grant it to me with your own hands?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I am beyond grateful...――

Durandal bows reverently. As I pin
the medal-shaped brooch onto her left arm...
it gleams brightly in the evening sun.
